A line-item format change in **OrderService** affects **5 services within two hops**:

| Distance | Affected service | Dependency path |
|---|---|---|
| 1 hop | **BillingService** | Depends on OrderService |
| 1 hop | **ReportingService** | Depends on OrderService |
| 1 hop | **SearchService** | Depends on OrderService |

| 2 hops | **RenewalsWorker** | Depends on BillingService, which depends on OrderService |
